outlets.name: Tourist-Information Trier (trier-info.de)
outlets.credible: Official DMO of the city of Trier (German). Authoritative for Trier sights, museums, Weinstuben and gastronomy.

outlets.name: Visit Mosel / Mosellandtouristik (visitmosel.de, moselregion.com)
outlets.credible: Official regional tourism organisation for the German Mosel (Mosellandtouristik), German/English. Authoritative for wine towns, vinotheques and attractions valley-wide.

outlets.name: Stadt Cochem an der Mosel
outlets.credible: Official municipal site of Cochem (German/English). Primary source for Cochem attractions incl. the Bundesbank bunker.

outlets.name: Cochemer Sesselbahn / Pinnerkreuzbahn GmbH
outlets.credible: Official operator of Cochem's chairlift to the Pinnerkreuz viewpoint (German/English).

outlets.name: Stadt / Tourist-Info Traben-Trarbach
outlets.credible: Official town/tourist information for Traben-Trarbach (German). Primary for the Buddha-Museum, Grevenburg, Jugendstil quarter.

outlets.name: Ortsgemeinde / Tourist-Info Neumagen-Dhron
outlets.credible: Official site of 'Germany's oldest wine village' (German). Primary for the Roman wine ship Stella Noviomagi.

outlets.name: Stadt Zell (Mosel) / Zellerland
outlets.credible: Official municipal / tourism site for Zell (German). Primary for the Zeller Schwarze Katz wine and Collis-Turm.

outlets.name: Saar-Obermosel Touristik
outlets.credible: Official regional tourism board for the Saar–Upper-Mosel corner incl. Saarburg (German/English).

outlets.name: Stadt Saarburg
outlets.credible: Official municipal site of Saarburg (German). Primary for the town-centre waterfall, castle and Staden quarter.

outlets.name: Rheinland-Pfalz Tourismus (urlaub-in-rheinland-pfalz.de)
outlets.credible: Official state tourism portal for Rhineland-Palatinate (German). Broad, editorially maintained coverage of Mosel attractions.

outlets.name: Rheinland-Pfalz Tourismus GmbH (rlp-tourismus.com)
outlets.credible: Official state tourism marketing organisation for Rhineland-Palatinate (German), curated POI/gastronomy listings.

outlets.name: Rheinisches Landesmuseum Trier / Zentrum der Antike
outlets.credible: Official site of the state archaeological museum of Trier (GDKE Rheinland-Pfalz), German/English. Institutional authority.

outlets.name: Stadtmuseum Simeonstift Trier
outlets.credible: Official site of Trier's municipal museum in the Simeonstift (German/English).

outlets.name: Museum am Dom Trier (Bischöfliches Dom- und Diözesanmuseum)
outlets.credible: Official diocesan museum of Trier (German/English). Institutional authority for the Roman ceiling fresco and Christian art.

outlets.name: Buddha-Museum Traben-Trarbach
outlets.credible: Official site of the Buddha-Museum in the Jugendstil Kayser cellar (German/English).

outlets.name: Bundesbank-Bunker Cochem (Dokumentationsstätte)
outlets.credible: Official museum operating the former Bundesbank Cold-War bunker (German/English). Primary source.

outlets.name: Deutsche Stiftung Denkmalschutz
outlets.credible: Germany's private monument-protection foundation (German). Authoritative heritage documentation, e.g. Burgruine Landshut.

outlets.name: Deutsches Weininstitut (deutscheweine.de)
outlets.credible: The German Wine Institute, the national marketing/authority body for German wine (German/English). Authoritative on vineyards incl. the Calmont and estates.

outlets.name: wein.plus Wine Guide
outlets.credible: Established independent German-language wine guide/lexicon; producer descriptions used as a credible measure for estates (e.g. Reuscher-Haart, Piesport).

outlets.name: Meininger Verlag (meininger.de)
outlets.credible: Leading German wine and drinks trade publisher; producer profiles used as credible corroboration.

outlets.name: Rick Steves' Europe
outlets.credible: The definitive US-authored Europe travel authority; his Mosel Valley guide names Beilstein as his favourite village and the St.-Nikolaus-Hospital vinotheque as the place to taste Mosel wine.

outlets.name: Atlas Obscura
outlets.credible: Editorial travel outlet for unusual places; lists the Cochem Bundesbank bunker among things to do in Cochem.

outlets.name: Falstaff
outlets.credible: Major German-language food and wine guide/magazine; a credible editorial listing (e.g. Café Konditorei Razen, Trier).

outlets.name: Schlemmer Atlas
outlets.credible: Long-running German restaurant guide with editorial reviews; used as a credible corroborator for regional restaurants.

outlets.name: EinkaufsErlebnis Trier
outlets.credible: Curated Trier city gastronomy/retail portal (German); corroborating listing for old-town restaurants.

outlets.name: DeutschlandGourmet
outlets.credible: German-language restaurant directory with editorial descriptions; corroborating source.

outlets.name: Mosel-Inside – Mosel Valley Travel Guide
outlets.credible: Detailed German/English Mosel-valley travel guide; corroborating source for vinotheques and towns.

outlets.name: One Million Places
outlets.credible: Established German travel-editorial site; corroborating coverage of Beilstein/Bernkastel.

outlets.name: Goruma Städte- & Länderportal
outlets.credible: German geography/city reference portal; corroborating factual source for Trier landmarks.

outlets.name: Trier erleben
outlets.credible: Trier city guide/blog; corroborating local source for viewpoints (Mariensäule, Petrisberg).
